message: This fixture is intentionally larger than one TAR header block so the remote JSONL path exercises archive probing without being detected as an archive.
It contains ordinary JSON Lines records served through the real HTTP fixture, preserving the same network path that command-line users exercise.
The test asserts the complete output rather than only a record count, ensuring that the inspected prefix is restored before streaming continues.
No compression or archive container is involved in this fixture because it verifies that ordinary remote JSONL remains a streaming operation.
